title: Standards of professional responsibility and mandatory reporting not affected.
bodyText:
This chapter does not affect:

(1) The professional responsibility obligations and standards applicable to a lawyer or other licensed professional; or

(2) The obligation of a person to report abuse or neglect, abandonment, or exploitation of a child or adult under the law of this State.
bodyHtml:
[§658G-13]  Standards of professional responsibility and mandatory reporting not affected.  This chapter does not affect:

     (1)  The professional responsibility obligations and standards applicable to a lawyer or other licensed professional; or

     (2)  The obligation of a person to report abuse or neglect, abandonment, or exploitation of a child or adult under the law of this State. [L 2012, c 207, pt of §1]
